description: Maps an eight bit input to an eight bit output through a 256-value table, with twenty banks of tables to scan

params.text: Picks one of the twenty banks of tables, whose name is drawn in the display
Scans through the tables of the selected bank, crossfading between neighbouring tables, 0 to 100%
Shifts where the input value is read in the table, a full turn shifting by all 256 positions

inputs.text: Sets one bit of the input value, a voltage above 1V counting as a one and anything lower as a zero
Sets the whole input value, one channel per bit, a channel above 1V counting as a one
Selects the bank, 0.5V per bank across the twenty, and overrides the bank selector while a cable is patched
Sets the scan position, 0-10V across the bank, and overrides the Wave knob while a cable is patched
Sets the shift, 0-10V across all 256 positions, and overrides the Phase knob while a cable is patched

outputs.text: Carries 10V while that bit of the table value is set and 0V while it is clear
Carries all eight bits of the table value at once, one channel per bit

notes: the display draws the table currently selected and names its bank
the twenty banks of tables are read from the file default_rom.json in the plugin's res folder; a file named rom.json placed beside it is read in its place whenever it loads without errors
